responsibility: This file implements the mc-boot runtime's pseudo-printf formatting engine on top of DynamicStrings. It expands escape sequences, substitutes a small fixed number of encapsulated arguments into format strings via the Sprintf0-Sprintf4 family, handles percent escaping, and relies on StringConvert for numeric text formation, making it the higher-level string templating layer rather than the raw numeric or stream I/O code.
same_name_distinction: Implements the formatting behavior declared in GFormatStrings.h, including placeholder substitution, percent handling, and escape-sequence decoding over DynamicStrings; the header only exposes those entry points.
